chunks: And from a letter of his (peace be upon him) to Salmān al-Fārisī (may Allah have mercy on him), before the days of his caliphate.
ai.seo_question: When was the first letter of Imam Ali to Salman al-Farsi written?
ai.summary: This heading marks the beginning of Imam Ali’s correspondence with Salman al-Farisi, offering a glimpse into his leadership style and intellectual rapport before his formal accession to the caliphate. It highlights the continuity of their relationship maintained from the Prophet’s time through the Rashidun era, underscoring Salman’s role as a key companion and advisor. The timing suggests that the letter’s advice was rooted in established principles rather than newly acquired political authority.
